items.transcript: What I love about La Jolla is coming across these properties that only come up like once every 50 years. This particular property has one and a half acres. It also has 16 garages because the former owner was a classic car collector. Because he built these structures, it gives you so many development opportunities. You could build up a second story here. You could convert these into ADUs, gymnasium. You've already got the tennis court that could be converted to pickleball, basketball, squash. So there's just so much here and there's so much opportunities with this blank canvas. And it's just cool getting to represent a property like this.
